_README: Per-client Amazon Ad/Sales Audit config. Copy to config.<client>-<market>.json (gitignored; only this TEMPLATE is committed). Fill every <...> placeholder. Paths in inputs{} may use ~ and repo-relative paths. Run: python tools/amazon-ad-audit/build_audit.py --config <this file> --preflight  → then --config <this file> to build. break-even ACOS is an ASSUMPTION until margin is confirmed; every red/amber verdict keys off it.
client_price_note: Optional but strongly recommended. The client's REAL selling price. DataDive reports the BUY BOX price, so during a hijack or stock-out it is a third party's and puts the client in the wrong place on the price/rating chart. Leave null to derive ASP from the Business Report (sales / units). client_dtc_price adds the brand's own-website price as a reference line.
brand_tokens_note: Substring, case-insensitive. Include real misspellings that carry brand intent; do NOT include dictionary words that merely resemble the brand.
core_tokens: <category phrase the product actually competes on>
core_tokens_note: Optional. Splits GENERIC into winnable CORE vs undifferentiated HEAD for the SQP demand figures. Without it every generic term counts as core, i.e. the old two-way behaviour. Include the category language a shopper uses for THIS product ('under eye brightener'); leave OUT the shelf above it ('makeup', 'beauty'). Head terms are real demand but no single listing wins them, so counting them as addressable overstates the category by an order of magnitude and makes category share look far worse than it is.
asin_groups_note: Optional. null or {} for an ungrouped single-line catalog. Groups map SQP files and Business-Report ASINs to product lines.
datadive_niche: <nicheId, or empty if no organic overlay>

inputs.datadive_niche_json: <path to saved DataDive niche keywords JSON (Claude pulls via MCP), or empty>
inputs.datadive_competitors_json: <optional path to DataDive competitors JSON, or empty>
inputs.rank_radar_json: <optional path to a DataDive Rank Radar payload (keyword + ranks over time) for the standard fig_rank_movement chart, or empty>

delivery.drive_folder: {drive}/04_Sales Audits/<Client>   (token resolves per machine; never an absolute path)

branding._note: Branded rendering (render_branded.py) → A4 .docx + .pdf. Agency identity (palette/fonts/name/URL) comes from _local/branding/branding.json — see tools/amazon-ad-audit/BRANDING.md. first_time=true renders the dark cover page; regular update audits set false (no cover). Requires the local brand/ assets (prepare_brand_assets.py or your own). Falls back to plain md_to_docx if assets/Chrome are missing.
branding.cover_subtitle: A straight look at the account, with recommendations on where to start.
